findings.title: links.yml fails every weekly run on internal links and never opens its issue: lychee is given local files without a root dir, and the whole report is passed as the issue body
findings.location: .github/workflows/links.yml:34 (lychee args: local 'site/dist/**/*.html', no --root-dir, --base or --scheme) and :41 (gh issue create ... --body-file lychee-report.md)
findings.claim: lychee reports every root-relative internal link of every page as an error. The report then exceeds GitHub's 65536-character limit for an issue body, so the job fails every week and no issue is ever opened.
findings.expected: SPEC 7.7 Links row: 'external links checked weekly by links.yml, where a failure opens an issue and does not fail a build'. Only external links are judged, and a broken one leads to an issue.
findings.observed: On GitHub, scheduled run 39258486524 (2026-10-19, head aea18020; links.yml is identical at b9b8504) ended in failure. The lychee step printed hundreds of '[ERROR] ... Cannot resolve root-relative link '/mutation_game/credits/': To resolve root-relative links in local files, provide a root dir' and exited 2. 'Open an issue on failure' then failed with 'GraphQL: Body is too long (maximum is 65536 characters) (createIssue)', and no issue was opened. Offline at b9b8504, the build's 32 HTML files hold 762 root-relative links, about 118000 to 128000 characters of such errors before any external link.
findings.reproduction: gh run view 39258486524 --repo johnjanik/mutation_game (the issue step shows X); the job log is GitHub job 118079079714433 (excerpts in redteam/rt12-p4/github-links-run-39258486524.txt). Offline, in a checkout of b9b8504 plus this branch: npm ci && npm run build && node redteam/rt12-p4/redteam-RT-12-links-yml.mjs . -> two FAIL lines and exit 1.
findings.proposedFix: Limit lychee to remote links (for example --scheme https --scheme http) or give --root-dir site/dist with a base that maps /<repo>/. Truncate or attach the report rather than passing it whole as --body-file.

findings.title: npm run e2e fails in CI on every run: registry-weight.spec.ts reads built files by URL with the /<repo>/ base still in the path
findings.location: site/tests/e2e/registry-weight.spec.ts:36 (u.replace(/^\//, '') strips only the leading slash) and :18 and :46 (join(site/dist, path))
findings.claim: The regression test of RT-FIX P3-RT-07-04 turns component-url values into file paths by dropping only the leading slash. At any non-root base it opens site/dist/<base>/_astro/..., which does not exist. In GitHub Actions the base is /mutation_game/, so ci.yml's 'Browser tests' step fails.
findings.expected: SPEC 7.8: ci.yml runs the tests of 7.7, and 7.2 item 10 says in CI the base follows from GITHUB_REPOSITORY. npm run e2e passes at the base ci.yml builds with, as it does at /.
findings.observed: With GITHUB_REPOSITORY=johnjanik/mutation_game, the build exits 0 and registry-weight.spec.ts fails with 'ENOENT: no such file or directory, open .../site/dist/mutation_game/_astro/client.svelte.XNJPo5Ip.js', in the full CI simulation and every time alone. On the root-base build the same spec passes (1 passed).
findings.reproduction: In a clean clone of b9b8504 plus this branch, after npm ci: PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=<browsers> bash redteam/rt12-p4/redteam-RT-12-registry-weight-base.sh <clone> <logdir> 5220 prints 'ci registry-weight.spec.ts exit 1 -- Error: ENOENT ... site/dist/mutation_game/_astro/...' and 'root registry-weight.spec.ts exit 0'. Equivalent with the repository's own config: GITHUB_REPOSITORY=johnjanik/mutation_game npm run build && GITHUB_REPOSITORY=johnjanik/mutation_game npx playwright test site/tests/e2e/registry-weight.spec.ts. The whole ci.yml sequence: redteam/rt12-p4/redteam-RT-12-ci-sim.sh.
findings.specRef: SPEC.md 7.8 (ci.yml runs the tests of 7.7); 7.2 item 10; 7.7 npm run e2e
findings.proposedFix: Strip import.meta base from the URL (siteAndBase(process.env).base) and read from outDirFrom(process.env), as basepath.spec.ts does. Add the GITHUB_REPOSITORY base to a local check of the e2e suite.

findings.title: On Node 22.12 to 22.17, which engines and SPEC 7.1 admit, npm run build exits 1 (postbuild links.mjs), and npm run size and lab exit 1: plain node imports astro.config.mjs, which imports a .ts file
findings.location: scripts/links.mjs:199, run by package.json:18 postbuild (new in RT-FIX P3-RT-12-01); scripts/size.mjs:344; scripts/lab.mjs:741; site/astro.config.mjs:11 (import of ./src/lib/unverifiedRegistry.ts)
findings.claim: Node strips TypeScript types by default only from 22.18. links.mjs, size.mjs and lab.mjs import site/astro.config.mjs with plain node, and that file imports unverifiedRegistry.ts, so on 22.12 to 22.17 they stop with ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION. Since the round 1 fix put links.mjs in postbuild, this breaks npm run build itself, along with e2e:basepath. scripts/presets.mjs re-runs itself with --experimental-strip-types for exactly this range; the others do not.
findings.expected: CONTRACTS 1 engines '>=22.12'; SPEC 7.1 Node '22.12 or later (LTS line 22)' and 7.2 item 1 'requires Node 22.12 or later'. The commands of 7.7 succeed on every admitted Node.
findings.observed: On Node v22.12.0 (official binary, npm package node-linux-x64@22.12.0), npm run build builds 32 pages, then exits 1 with 'links: Unknown file extension ".ts" for .../site/src/lib/unverifiedRegistry.ts'. node scripts/size.mjs exits 1 with the same message. node --experimental-strip-types scripts/links.mjs exits 0 ('1040 internal links ... 0 problems'). On 22.22 the same failure appears with node --no-experimental-strip-types scripts/links.mjs, which is the switch P4-A2's decision used to test presets.mjs's 22.12 to 22.17 path.
findings.reproduction: In a clean clone of b9b8504 plus this branch, after npm ci: bash redteam/rt12-p4/redteam-RT-12-node-minimum.sh <clone> <scratch>/node22.12 <scratch>/logs prints 'npm run build on Node 22.12.0: exit 1 -- links: Unknown file extension ".ts" ...', 'node scripts/size.mjs: exit 1 ...' and 'node --experimental-strip-types scripts/links.mjs: exit 0'. Shortcut on Node 22.22: npm run build && node --no-experimental-strip-types scripts/links.mjs -> exit 1.
findings.proposedFix: Run the three scripts with --experimental-strip-types on Node below 22.18, as presets.mjs does, or move siteAndBase and outDirFrom into a plain .mjs module that the scripts import without the integration. Alternatively raise engines and .nvmrc to >=22.18 with a recorded decision.

findings.title: npm run report presents the report of a release build that failed: the report is marked complete at astro:build:done, and postbuild's link check fails afterwards
findings.location: site/src/lib/unverifiedRegistry.ts:216-230 (complete: true written in astro:build:done); package.json:18 (postbuild runs after it); scripts/report.mjs:36-40 (checks only report.complete)
findings.claim: The round 1 fix rests on the build-done marker. Since RT-FIX P3-RT-12-01 a release build can still fail after that marker, in postbuild, and npm run report then accepts and prints its report as the release report.
findings.expected: The fix's own decision says 'a failed release build is never presented as the release report' (DECISIONS.md, RT-FIX-P3-toolchain-b, P3-RT-12-06). SPEC 7.3 and 7.7 describe the report of a release build.
findings.observed: Copy with one dead internal link: RELEASE=1 npm run build exits 1 ('links: 971 internal links on 32 pages of site/dist checked, 1 problems'). npm run report then exits 0 with 'report: open items report of 2026-10-24T12:54:02.049Z: 8 open items used on 8 pages, 0 unknown items'.
findings.reproduction: bash redteam/rt12-p4/redteam-RT-12-run-mutations.sh <clean clone of b9b8504 with npm ci> <scratch> deadlink prints 'deadlink: release-build exit 1' and 'deadlink: report exit 0'.
findings.specRef: SPEC.md 7.3 (<Unverified> report of a release build), 7.7 npm run report; DECISIONS.md RT-FIX-P3-toolchain-b 'a complete release report'
findings.proposedFix: Mark the report complete only after the link check (for example, links.mjs sets complete after it passes), or have report.mjs also require the postbuild's success marker.

findings.title: scripts/presets.mjs, the prebuild step of every build, declares its own '@engine' alias, so site/tsconfig.json is not the one declaration the build reads
findings.location: scripts/presets.mjs:31 and :46 (resolveTypeScript maps '@engine' to packages/engine/src/index.ts); site/tests/unit/aliases-one-source.test.ts:136-142 (the copy scan does not read scripts/)
findings.claim: The P3-RT-12-05 fix made site/tsconfig.json 'the one declaration that the build, the type check and npm test read'. The prebuild resolves '@engine' from a second, hard-coded declaration, so it keeps passing when the tsconfig target is broken.
findings.expected: CONTRACTS 1 path aliases; DECISIONS.md RT-FIX-P3-toolchain-b 'one declaration of the path aliases'. A broken '@engine' in site/tsconfig.json fails every tool that resolves it.
findings.observed: With '@engine' in site/tsconfig.json pointing at packages/engine/src/rt12-no-such-file.ts: node scripts/presets.mjs --check exits 0, and the prebuild writes the presets. astro build exits 1 ('Rolldown failed to resolve import "@engine" from .../site/src/pages/dev/draw-time.astro'). The two declarations agree today.
findings.reproduction: bash redteam/rt12-p4/redteam-RT-12-run-mutations.sh <clean clone of b9b8504 with npm ci> <scratch> engine-alias prints 'engine-alias: presets-check exit 0' and 'engine-alias: preview-build exit 1'.
findings.proposedFix: Have the resolve hook read compilerOptions.paths from site/tsconfig.json, and add scripts/ to the scan of aliases-one-source.test.ts.

notes: Intermittent, not reproduced on demand, so reported as a note only. In the CI simulation, e2e T07.spec.ts 'T1 colour-class panel' failed in startFixtures with 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'Symbol(filename)') at push_element (/tmp/two-games-ssr-test-cache-3272f75e/deps_ssr/dev-BKp52Qfo.js)'. This is the shared-SSR-cache failure of DECISIONS.md P2-A6, in a cache the e2e run had itself created in a fresh clone. Run alone it passed. 12 concurrent cold-cache SSR loads passed (redteam-RT-12-ssr-cache-race.mjs). 6 concurrent runs of state-classify-once.test.ts from two checkouts sharing one TMPDIR passed (redteam-RT-12-shared-ssr-cache.sh).

Related to the note above: several Vite caches are not keyed by checkout, so every worktree on the machine shares them, against MERGE P2 2.1's per-checkout rule. They are state-classify-once.test.ts ('two-games-rt03-classify-cache') and the e2e fixture build caches (two-games-p2a7-fixtures-cache, -p3a5-fixtures-cache, -hydration-cache, -numbers-fixture-cache, -kostant-prediction-cache). GATE removes /tmp caches by hand before each gate (gate-G4.md §1); no command and no CI step does this.

Under load 16 to 18, the CI-simulation e2e also failed on board-load '12-cycle ... one long task' (60.7 ms against 50), T10 'no long task after a ring click' and T15 'announcements of a capped play, recorded' (last announcement 'Board square.'). Each passed alone under the CI base; T15 passed 3 of 3. These are load-sensitive tests (RT-07 and RT-11), not base-path effects.

Round 1's reproducers run-mutations.sh, basepath-timing.sh, ci-base-e2e.sh, run-typecheck-mutations.sh and report-after-failed-release.sh were not in the round1/reproducers copy. Their attacks were rebuilt here as redteam-RT-12-run-mutations.sh, redteam-RT-12-ci-sim.sh and the mutation fixtures.

Possible deploy issue, not checkable from here (the repository environments and Pages API paths are refused by this container's proxy). GitHub's github-pages environment often allows deployments only from the default branch. A run triggered by a v* tag could then be refused by environment protection the first time the owner pushes a tag. Worth checking when DEPLOY_PAGES is set.
The webServer has reuseExistingServer: !process.env.CI, so outside CI (GATE's runs) an existing server on 4321 would be reused. This was not observed; it is a risk on a machine shared by agents.
siteAndBase: GITHUB_REPOSITORY alone, without CI, gives the /repo/ base. The function never reads CI. This is recorded as attack 13 asks.

The root 'npm run preview' cannot take a port (the root script passes it to npm), and port 4321 is reserved here, so the root preview command was not started. 'npm run preview -w site -- --port' is what Playwright starts, and it worked in every run.
Content, for the content lenses: gate-G4.md §11 says Appendix E item 7 shows nothing in a release build. m7-geometry.mdx:158 gives E7 a fallback, and the release report says 'fallback shown' for E7.
GitHub annotations of the existing runs: ubuntu-latest moves to Ubuntu 26 from 19 Oct, and actions/upload-artifact@v5 runs on Node 24. Neither is a finding.

Not runnable here: WebKit and Firefox (MathML spec skipped), GitHub itself (workflows judged statically, plus the real run history), and lychee (GitHub release downloads are refused, so P4-RT-12-01's offline reproduction counts the links instead of running lychee).
